question: Which aspects of Rāma are invoked to protect the hands and heart?
premises: The lord of Sītā is asked to protect the two hands
The conqueror of Jāmadagnya is asked to protect the heart
inference: Specific aspects of Rāma are invoked to guard the hands and the heart.
plain_english: May the lord of Sītā protect the two hands; may the conqueror of Jāmadagnya protect the heart.
